system.description:
• Effect: Once per day, when HP is reduced to twice your level or less, immediately gain bonus HP equal to twice your level.
  • The bonus HP absorb incoming damage first
  • Any remaining bonus HP are removed at combat's end
  • If reduced to 0 or negative HP before activation, it triggers automatically — if the resulting total is 1 or more HP, the Barbarian keeps fighting
  • Cannot prevent death from a blow that would kill you outright

activities.name: Primeval Will
activities.text: When reduced to twice your level in HP or less, gain bonus HP equal to twice your level until combat ends.
